name: Rhythm Path
description: Solves the level, then shows its inputs as a scrolling rhythm-game chart.

auto-solve.name: Auto-solve on level start
auto-solve.description: Automatically find a path through the level when you open it (only if no saved chart exists). You can always solve manually from the pause menu.

time-limit.name: Solver time limit (seconds)
time-limit.description: Time allowed for finding a path. After this the solver keeps the furthest path found. Centering the timings afterwards can take up to half this long again (at least 30 s), plus a final replay.

steps-per-update.name: Physics steps per simulated frame
steps-per-update.description: How many 240 TPS physics steps the solver runs per simulated game frame. 4 matches playing at 60 FPS, 1 matches 240 FPS. Lower is more faithful to high-FPS play, higher solves faster. The final check uses the same value.

input-resolution.name: Input resolution (ticks)
input-resolution.description: The solver may only change an input every N physics ticks (240 per second) while searching. 1 finds the most solutions; 2-4 search faster. If "Center inputs in their timing window" is on, each note is then moved to the middle of its working range, tick by tick (skipped in exact replay mode).

frame-budget.name: Solver CPU budget per frame (ms)
frame-budget.description: How much time per rendered frame the solver may use. The game is hidden while solving, so a high value makes solving faster; the progress screen just updates less often.

refine-timing.name: Center inputs in their timing window
refine-timing.description: After a path is found, move every press/release to the middle of the range of ticks that still works, so the chart is as forgiving as possible to hit.

refine-window.name: Timing refine search range (ticks)
refine-window.description: How far (in 240 TPS ticks) each input is shifted each way while looking for its safe window.

scroll-speed.name: Scroll speed
scroll-speed.description: How fast the notes move toward the timing line, in screen units per second of level time.

hit-line-x.name: Timing line distance from left edge

always-show-p2.name: Always show the P2 lane
always-show-p2.description: Show the P2 lane even on levels that are not 2-player. When off, the P2 lane only appears on 2-player levels.

show-judgements.name: Show hit timing feedback
show-judgements.description: Show how early/late each of your presses and releases was compared to the chart.

visual-offset-ms.name: Visual offset (ms)
visual-offset-ms.description: Leave at 0 for exact game-synced timing. Positive values make notes arrive earlier (compensates for input lag on your setup).
